title: Apple squashes EU beef with new App Store rules
summary: Apple’s new EU App Store terms go into effect on October 1st. They will include a 26 percent commission for App Store apps that use Apple’s in-app purchase system, or a 20 percent fee for developers using alternate payment providers.
